newsitem.title: INDIA: India CARE retains the rating of Zee Telefilms.
newsitem.headline: India CARE retains the rating of Zee Telefilms.

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Thursday in a statement it retained the rating of CARE AA (FD) Double A for the fixed deposit programme of Zee Telefilms Ltd (ZTL) upto a limited of 100 million rupees.
ZTL reported a profit after tax of 288 million rupees on a turnover of 913 million rupees in 1996/97 compared to 230 million rupees and 882 million rupees respectively, in 1995/96.
A low debt equity ratio at 0.23 and a current ratio at 1.95 as on March 31, 1997, reflect the strong financial position of the company, CARE said in a statement.

The ZEE Network ('Zee', 'EL TV' and 'Zee Movies' channels, collectively) has emerged as a strong players enjoying significant viewer loyalty, despite competition from other satellite channels in India, CARE said.
